name: Intersection Target Method
definition: A 2D voxelization strategy for effectively 1D input that guarantees 8-connectivity (adjacent voxels share an edge or corner) and 4-separability (no 4-connected path of background voxels separates foreground components).
summary: The Intersection Target Method voxelizes 1D curves by including voxels only when the input intersects specific geometric targets, ensuring topological 8-connectivity and 4-separability unlike proximity-based methods.
